name: sdd
description: Subagent-Driven Development — delegate scoped work units to CLI agent harnesses (codex, agy, grok, kimi, qwen, mistral) as fresh-context subagents, fan out, collect structured results, and check account quota before you spend it; plus a video pipeline (yt-dlp, whisper, ffmpeg-frames, shazam) that turns a video URL into one transcript + visual-understanding JSON; plus the Jev decision model for ranking and routing at volume
